name: Surface-following Marching Cubes with Blocking
aliases: Surface-following marching cubes with blocking algorithm
definition: An alternative approach using surface-following marching cubes with a blocking algorithm for unbounded rendering and a point insert, 3D lookup cache.
summary: Surface-following Marching Cubes with Blocking is a surface extraction method for unbounded particle rendering that uses a coarse lookup grid and 3D cache to efficiently find nearby particles, unlike standard voxel-based approaches.
